name: Using the tools of the outside world
vision_statement: The AI uses the tool of each category the person's authority allows, and a category gains a better integration without any product rewriting its code.
opportunities: Each tool category is a solution and each integration an implementation, so a better search, file editor, operation caller or agent runner can replace an older one on its own measure.
solution_coherence: Tools lets the AI use the tool of a category and refuses a category the authority does not allow. Web Search brings in the live web. File Reading reads the files of a folder. File Editing changes one file by instruction. Connected System Operations calls a write operation of a connected system. Delegated Agent Sessions gives open-ended work to an agent that runs in its own session. Command Execution runs one shell command in a folder, bounded in time and output, refusing what must not run unattended and, where a sandbox exists, containing writes to the folder; the agent runners that execute a model's commands use it. Agent Action Format reads a model's reply in the format that model is trained on (a provider's native tool calls or the hub's text protocol) and runs each action in the folder; the loops that own their turn taking use it, and Delegated Agent Sessions is where the harnesses that do both are compared.
